Requires Android 11+ wireless debugging. The pairing code and port change every time you reopen the system dialog, so keep the dialog and the Venus notification visible throughout.
Note: some Huawei/Honor devices have no wireless debugging entry, and Android 14 vivo/iQOO devices may be restricted. On those devices, use cloud-game capture instead.
Enable developer options\nGo to Settings → About phone and tap Build number / System version 7 times until developer options are enabled.

Open wireless debugging details\nIn Settings → Developer options, find Wireless debugging and tap its title to open the details page. Do not tap only the switch, or the pairing-code entry will not be shown.

Get the pairing code\nOn the details page, enable wireless debugging and tap Pair device with pairing code. Note the 6-digit code and port, and keep the system dialog open. Reopening it generates a new code and port.

Enter in the notification shade\nDo not return to Venus or close the system pairing dialog: pull down the notification shade, find the “Pairing wireless debugging” notification, tap “Enter pairing code” and fill in the 6-digit code there. If port discovery fails, first tap “Enter pairing port” and use the port shown in the system dialog. If already paired, tap “Skip pairing and connect directly”.

Wait for capture\nPairing automatically connects and starts watching. Keep wireless debugging on, then open the gacha records page in Genshin Impact or Zenless Zone Zero. Once captured, the link is copied and a system toast is shown.

Find the result or retry\nBack on the Get Links page, the result stays under the ADB row and can be copied again. If it fails, repeat step 3 to reopen the system pairing dialog; if the connect port is not discovered, use Enter connect port in the notification.

Capture relies on persistent background networking. System/vendor power-saving policies (e.g. ColorOS background controls) may cut the capture network after the screen turns off or the app goes to background, causing game disconnects or even crashes.

How to: on the next settings page, set this app to "Unrestricted" and allow background activity — on ColorOS, enable "Allow full background behavior" under App info → Power consumption management.

Come back to the app after that to continue capturing.
